newsitem.title: UK: Average daily gold turnover rises in February - LBMA.
newsitem.headline: Average daily gold turnover rises in February - LBMA.

text.p: The average daily turnover of gold cleared through the London Bullion Market Association's (LBMA) clearing members in February was 40.3 million ounces up eight percent from 37.2 million ounces averaged in January.
The total volume was slightly lower for February but the fewer working days raised the average figure, the LBMA said.

However the value of the daily turnover increased by only six percent in February to $14.00 billion from $13.2 billion reflecting the lower average gold price of $346.58 per ounce compared with $355.10 in January.
The daily average silver volume cleared fell 6.6 percent to 275 million ounces from 294.4 million ounces.
The average value of the silver turnover was unchanged at $1.4 billion as the higher average silver price ($5.07 per ounce versus $4.77 in January) cancelled out February's lower total turnover.
